question: What do the satisfied goddesses of consciousness do after consuming the universe?
premises: The goddesses of consciousness are fully satisfied.
Bhairava rests in the full heart as the space of consciousness.
They abide in that deity without any difference.
inference: Satisfied consciousness rests non-dually in the heart of Bhairava.
plain_english: Satisfied, they rest without difference upon the god Bhairava, who dwells in the space of consciousness within the full heart of their own self.
